d: JDU Sushasan Diwas 2026 : bihar ki rajniti men janta dal yunaited ne 24 navanbar ko pure pradesh men 'sushasan divas' manane ki taiyari ki hai... is mauke par sabhi jila mukhyalyon men 'nitish sanvad' karyakram aayojit kie jaenge... parti is aayojan ke jarie nitish kumar ke mukhyamantri ke rup men 24 navanbar 2005 se shuru hue karyakal aur unke shasankal ke karyon ko janta ke bich rakhegi...karyakram men jediyu ke rashtriy karyakari adhyaksh sanjay jha, kendriy mantri lalan sinh samet kaee varishth neta alag-alag jilon men shamil honge... svasthy mantri nishant kumar bhi patna ke karyakram…
